historical_context.time_period: Corporate Exodus era, Mare Crisium continuity default in 2091
historical_context.location: Transfer Gallery Two inside Mare Crisium Receiving Cylinder, a Horizon Ventures lunar freight and repair habitat.
historical_context.summary: A convoy-linked insurance and credit failure turns an ordinary hatch watch into a thirty-six-hour contraction: residents must be classified, transferred, contracted, or left in de-funded volume while a worn pressure hatch threatens the final insured launch.

public_facts.text: Horizon Ventures joined launch capacity, fuel, cargo finance, debt contracts, and habitat provisioning into one transport economy.
The 2091 convoy failures brought shipping insurers and lunar creditors down on Horizon and contributed to its 2095 merger with TerraCore.

At Mare Crisium, continuity default sorted residents into continuity labor, financed transfer, and unsupported occupancy while separate offices withdrew credentials, scrip recognition, or maintained pressure volume.
Residents pooled oxygen, copied scrubber rotations, and staffed seals long enough for nine people to reach an independent ferry without signing revised contracts.

ambient_pressures.text: The insurer can close launch coverage, lunar creditors can refuse cargo finance, Horizon can classify labor and occupancy, and local workers alone know whether the physical seal is true.
The food loop and life-support plant depend on subcontract labor whose credentials can vanish before their material usefulness does.
A thirty-six-hour exodus window makes every kilogram, filter hour, manual skill, and verified seal part of the same departure bargain.

groups.label: Horizon continuity staff
institutional_logic: Keep the insured habitat, transfer gallery, manifests, and departure sequence operating through default.
material_incentives: Retain air, wages, assigned housing, and green continuity credentials while avoiding blame for an impossible contraction.
internal_virtues: A seal verified by the body, not merely the panel
internal_shames: Being reclassified after making oneself replaceable
prestige_markers: A dock cycle without lost air
taboo_triggers: Letting an auditor discover a defect before the shift does
emotional_display_norms: Fear becomes maintenance jokes, clipped timing calls, and over-careful paperwork.
trust_defaults: Trusts practiced workers and physical gauges more than remote classifications; still depends on credentials.
speech_register_cues: Mass, air, time, and seal language

groups.label: Lunar creditor and insurer offices
institutional_logic: Keep loans, cargoes, launches, and insured occupancy inside a risk envelope the office can price.
material_incentives: Preserve the habitat asset and later ore receipts without financing open-ended rescue or unsupported air.
internal_virtues: A manifest that matches covered bodies and cargo
internal_shames: Launching through an undocumented pressure fault
taboo_triggers: Treating human need as authority to spend creditor margin
Joining physical and administrative failures into one liability chain
emotional_display_norms: Urgency is translated into clocks, coverage conditions, and narrow statements of authority.
trust_defaults: Trusts instrumented tests and sealed records; treats local testimony as a claim requiring a cost owner.
speech_register_cues: Exact limits on what the office can authorize

groups.label: Unsupported residents and subcontract workers
institutional_logic: Keep one another breathing long enough for refusal or departure to remain physically possible.
material_incentives: Pool oxygen, preserve food-loop knowledge, retain tools, and reach transport without inheriting more work debt.
internal_shames: Leaving a neighbor outside a pressure plan
Confusing a live credential with safety
prestige_markers: A person moved through a cargo field
An extra sleep cycle bought collectively
taboo_triggers: A contract calling forced enrollment voluntary
A food worker classified as unrelated to survival
emotional_display_norms: Humor and practical sharing carry fear; nobody has spare time for a manifesto.
trust_defaults: Trusts witnessed skill and shared material cost; distrusts promises that arrive without air, mass, or access.
speech_register_cues: Bitter jokes about forms and bodily needs

cultural_pressure_fields.summary: Workers retain air and housing by preserving the same contraction machinery that can expel their neighbors.
cultural_pressure_fields.projection_use: Choices should make competence materially valuable while exposing who receives its protection.

cultural_pressure_fields.summary: The offices preserve legitimacy by treating occupancy, seal integrity, cargo finance, and departure coverage as separate prudent decisions.
cultural_pressure_fields.projection_use: Keep Nara's authority narrow and real; evidence becomes dangerous when it binds separate files into one causal chain.

cultural_pressure_fields.summary: Shared oxygen, copied maintenance knowledge, and unpaid watches can create a small exit interval without abolishing the default.
cultural_pressure_fields.projection_use: Hope must appear as people, air, skill, and time rather than future movement rhetoric.

target_self_read: People keeping one another alive until transport exists
misread_patterns: Treats material care as an unfunded extension of liability
Treats shared skill as unauthorized operation
factional_misread_matrix.projection_use: Nara can perceive the physical danger accurately while still reducing residents to a coverage problem.

observer_read: Neighbors wearing the credential that closes the door
target_self_read: People with no authority over the default
misread_patterns: Residents can mistake constrained competence for full authority
Credentialed workers can mistake continued usefulness for safety
factional_misread_matrix.projection_use: Make solidarity costly and local rather than automatic across classification lines.

role_pressure_fields.summary: A continuity-classified worker who alone knows the worn hatch's second-stroke truth at the start of the scene.
obligations: Decide who may share the skill
failure_modes: Letting personal indispensability become another contract

role_pressure_fields.summary: A materially essential ecology worker rendered unsupported when her firm's contract is suspended.
failure_modes: Being reclassified after the manifest closes
Keeping food alive while people are removed

role_pressure_fields.summary: A Horizon clerk who can edit live fields until creditor locks arrive, but cannot finance air or launch a shuttle.
failure_modes: Mistaking a field for a fact
Saving a person by falsifying property

role_pressure_fields.summary: A risk officer who can continue or close insured departure and require physical tests, but cannot make Horizon's classifications humane.
failure_modes: A clean file preserving a dirty outcome
Closing the only exit because the hatch is unsafe
Pricing a coupled failure after it harms people

known_context.text: Sera knows Transfer Gallery Two, Hatch MCR-2, the honest gauge, the second stroke, local cuffs, and the immediate departure sequence.

beliefs.text: Sera believes a formal right to depart is useless unless air, mass, a working seal, and an accepting vehicle exist together.

misreads.text: She may overestimate how far technical indispensability lets her pressure creditor or manifest authority.

must_not_know.text: Sera cannot know that the 2095 SolEx merger will inherit this procedure; the ending may foreshadow only through arriving TerraCore auditors.

known_context.text: Mika knows the food loop, her gray credential, her household's air balance, and any seal or scrubber procedure Sera visibly teaches her.

beliefs.text: Mika treats copied working knowledge as more portable than a subcontract credential.

misreads.text: She may treat Davin's discretion as broader than the manifest fields he still controls.

must_not_know.text: Mika cannot use the second-stroke hatch procedure unless the chosen branch teaches or reveals it.

known_context.text: Nara knows the insured launch conditions, creditor exposure, instrument readings, and evidence presented to her booth.

beliefs.text: She believes a bounded unsafe departure can destroy the remaining asset and make every household worse off.

misreads.text: She can correctly diagnose pressure risk while misreading unpaid mutual aid as unpriced occupancy rather than survival capacity.

must_not_know.text: Nara cannot know hidden transfers, copied schedules, or shared skills unless the gallery, cuff records, or participants expose them.

author_only_boundaries.text: The Mare Crisium default contributes to creditor pressure that culminates in Horizon's 2095 merger with TerraCore, but participants in 2091 do not know that outcome.
The nine-person mutual-aid success is a small historical fact, not the founding of Aya or another mature movement.
